attributes.additional_details:

attributes.background:
Call on the UK Government to reform Statutory Sick Pay .
better reflects the real cost of living. Nobody should have to choose between recovering from illness and being able to afford food, rent and essential bills. We deserve a sick that is 80% for  full time jobs

rejection.details:
Petitions need to call on the Government or Parliament to take a specific action.

We're not sure exactly what you'd like the Government or Parliament to do. For both full time and part-time employees there is an entitlement of either £123.25 or 80%, whichever is lowest. You can find more information about statutory sick pay here: https://www.gov.uk/statutory-sick-pay

You could start a new petition explaining clearly what you would like the Government or Parliament to do.

You may also wish to sign the following petition which calls for a similar action:

Increase Statutory Sick Pay to match minimum wage
https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/776976
